summary: Prudential plc furnished a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, disclosing PDMR dealings under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. Four executives—Chief Risk and Compliance Officer Avnish Kalra, CFO Ben Bulmer, Chief Human Resources Officer Catherine Chia, and Chief Transformation Officer Kenneth Rappold—each acquired 303 ordinary shares of 5 pence at nil cost on 2026-09-22 via the Prudential All Employee Share Purchase Plan on the London Stock Exchange. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural terms appear; these are routine matching-share awards, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle; watch for further PDMR notices.
